sources.title: Model 500 Telephone British ring
sources.author: CianMcCann
sources.what_it_shows: A real Western Electric-type Model 500 rotary telephone's electromechanical bell ringer, British double-ring cadence (two ~0.35 s rings, 3.0 s period), 6 bursts in 24 s. Source is recorded hot (decoded float peaks ~1.97) and carries a DC offset and 50/120/150 Hz hum; the bell's own partials at ~1231, 3261 and 5900 Hz ring on between bursts.
sources.verified_date_or_place: Recorded 2012-06-07 (Commons DateTimeOriginal); place not stated: unverified
sources.used_as: S-RING: one double-ring burst (source 8.22-10.17 s) -> stems R1, R2, R3, R4
sources.decoded_from: original Ogg Vorbis (22.05 kHz stereo); Commons SHA-1 f1baddd95a56fd6c072bbfe6c72f8b0beaddd62d matches the download

absences.found: No openly licensed recording of a bed or bedding. Nearest: 'Creaky wooden swivel chair.ogg' (chocoholic, PDsounds, Public domain; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Creaky_wooden_swivel_chair.ogg), downloaded to /home/user/bolas/paeleo/scion/oulipo/films/sources/un-homme-qui-dort/sound/raw/bed_chair_creak.ogg.mp3 for reference. It is a chair, so it is NOT used as a bed sound.
absences.proposal: Declared silence at picture 1.6: no S-BED cue. The wake is carried by S-ROOM alone. If the director insists on a creak, the chair recording may be cued only if credited and ledgered as 'wooden chair creak (not a bed)'; no kit synthesis is proposed.

absences.searched: 'night street', 'street ambience', 'city night traffic', 'night traffic', 'night city', 'at night street', 'noche calle', 'urban ambience'
absences.found: Only one usable night street recording under an allowed licence (Cebu City at night, CC BY-SA 4.0). 'Karlova' Prague street files (PD) were rejected: daytime, with people. Speech absence in the chosen window is by a pitch-autocorrelation check, not by ear.
absences.proposal: Use the Cebu window 60.0-65.0 s. The editor should listen once; if a voice is heard, shift street_start in steps of 0.5 s among the zero-voiced windows (8.5-13.5, 9.0-14.0 ... listed in the build notes) and rebuild.

absences.searched: upload.wikimedia.org originals for the steps WAV and street Ogg
absences.found: Originals returned HTTP 429 (Retry-After 600) repeatedly; Commons' own MP3 transcodes of the same files were fetched instead. The room tone transcode was chosen deliberately to stay inside the 30 MB budget.
absences.proposal: None needed; the licence attaches to the file page. Recorded in decoded_from.
